bgAlt: Packed auditorium at Rajrangam theatre festival
label: Annual Festival
description: Rajasthan's premier national-level theatre festival, successfully organized on 8 occasions by Actors Theatre Rajasthan in association with the Ministry of Culture, Government of India. The recent 8th Rajrangam (14–15 May 2026) at Jawahar Kala Kendra (JKK), Jaipur, featured flagship plays (Flirt, Molière's Tartuffe, and the folk musical Gopichand Bhartrihari) alongside a national seminar and art exhibitions.
